The '''HS-19 cargo loading transport skimmer''', often referred to as simply a '''load skimmer''', was a model of [[skimmer]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation]]. Designed for carrying cargo, one such skimmer was owned by an [[Aki-Aki]] resident of [[Pasaana]]. [[Poe Dameron]] hotwired the skimmer when he and other [[Resistance]] members needed to [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|escape]] from [[First Order]] forces.<ref name="TROS VD" />
